glosses: club (an association of members joining together for some common purpose, especially sports or recreation)
club (an implement to hit the ball in certain ball games, such as golf)

examples.text: Chi altro è in questo club?
examples.en: Who else is in this club?

examples.text: A volte lo vedo al club.
examples.en: Sometimes I see him at the club.
What club do you belong to?

examples.text: Ci sono molti club nella tua città?
examples.en: Are there many clubs in your city?
